q1_issues.issue: The reified 'say' attitude carries no Theme, so the whole complement clause ('the ECB had not exhausted its ammunition for rate cuts'), including its negation, is left unrepresented.

The ECB's possession of ammunition is asserted as a top-level fact even though it occurs only inside the (never emitted) complement of 'saying', which denies exhaustion rather than reporting possession.
'reported in an interview' is slotted as spatial Location, but an interview is an occasion rather than a place, so the non-place rule points to the surface-preposition oblique instead.
The argument PP 'for rate cuts' on 'ammunition' is dropped entirely — no rate_cut symbol or For oblique appears anywhere.

q2_gaps: a wholly negated proposition as a sealed complement ('saying that X had NOT V-ed'): a seal is a term argument and carries no polarity, so the negation has no carrier inside it
notes: The matrix layers (the dilute event, the reduced relative 'reported in an interview on Tuesday') are structurally sound; the failure is concentrated in the 'saying' complement, whose content survives only as two orphan atoms about ammunition.
